title: a proof that sends mail on the live bus marks it as testing, so its bounce raises no live trouble
assumption_check: Load-bearing: the live bus and shim skip the trouble for a marked body. Measured: Trouble store on akiendelllinux, read by the orchestrator 2026-11-14: 8 open mail-testing-ad7caca4d54c-recipient-*-has-no-receiver and 7 mail-tester-has-no-verb-no_such_verb_60cc220da787. Read at origin/main d6bebdfb7: cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_probe_carry.py test_the_shim_fires_the_carrier_against_the_pulse_context posts a by_text body (no mark) to a receiverless testing-named recipient; cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_bounce_answers_the_request_that_bore_it.py sends body={} to the tester for an undeclared verb. The bus server and shim._bounce_to_sender skip the trouble only for a body carrying testing_mark.mark_of (ticket b3386f431ae3); the NAME does not count. shim._return_if_marked returns a return-kind mark unacted, before the verb is read, so the bounce proof needs the perform kind.
builder_check: D1: THE MARKS. cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_probe_carry.py's probe carry adds testing_mark.FIELD: mark('ad7caca4d54c') (return kind) to the poke body; cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_bounce_answers_the_request_that_bore_it.py's live request carries mark('60cc220da787', PERFORM), so the tester's shim still checks the verb and bounces, and the bounce inherits the mark. D2: PROOFS. Each tooth asserts the mark rides back (the posted poke's body; the bounce's body), which is the condition under which the receiver emits test_bounce_disposed instead of raising.
